question: What is the total net revenue in the data?
sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales
text: The total net revenue in the data is £18,942,645.83.

question: How many orders are there in total?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT invoice_no) AS total_orders FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled
text: There are 39,536 orders in total.

question: How many different products were sold at least once?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT product_key) AS distinct_products_sold FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled
text: 4903 different products were sold at least once.

question: How many registered customers placed at least one order?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.customer_key) AS registered_customers FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_customer c USING (customer_key) WHERE NOT c.is_guest AND NOT f.is_cancelled
text: 5853 registered customers placed at least one order.

question: What is the average order value?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no), 2) AS aov FROM fact_sales f WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled
text: The average order value is £497.25.

question: How many units were sold in total?
sql: SELECT sum(quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled
text: 11,188,277 units were sold in total.

question: How many cancellation invoices are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS cancellation_invoices FROM fact_sales WHERE invoice_no LIKE 'C%'
text: There are 17,926 cancellation invoices.

question: What is the total value of all cancellations?
sql: SELECT round(sum(line_amount), 2) AS total_cancellations FROM fact_sales WHERE is_cancelled = true
text: The total value of all cancellations is £716,808.03.

question: On how many different days did the shop receive at least one order?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT date_key) AS days FROM fact_sales WHERE NOT is_cancelled

question: What are the gross sales before cancellations?

question: What is the average net revenue per registered customer?

question: What was the net revenue in each year?
sql: SELECT d.year, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
text: The net revenue in 2009 was £779,174. In 2010, it was £9,143,544, and in 2011, it was £9,019,928.

question: What was the net revenue of the best month of 2011?
sql: SELECT d.month, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
text: The net revenue of the best month of 2011 was £1,428,271.

question: What was the net revenue in November 2011?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 AND d.month = 11
text: The net revenue in November 2011 was £1,428,271.25.

question: What was the net revenue in each quarter of 2011?
sql: SELECT d.quarter, round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.year = 2011 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
text: The net revenue for each quarter of 2011 was as follows: Q1: £1,758,757, Q2: £1,938,540, Q3: £2,391,341, and Q4: £2,931,290.

question: By how many percent did net revenue grow from 2010 to 2011?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN d.year = 2010 THEN f.line_amount END) AS a, sum(CASE WHEN d.year = 2011 THEN f.line_amount END) AS b FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key)) SELECT round(100 * (b / a - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM m
text: Net revenue decreased by 1.4% from 2010 to 2011.

question: How many orders were placed on weekends?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) AS orders FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.is_weekend AND NOT f.is_cancelled
text: 4,854 orders were placed on weekends.

question: How many orders were placed on the busiest day of the week?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.invoice_no) AS orders FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled GROUP BY d.day_name ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1
text: On the busiest day of the week, 8,170 orders were placed.

question: What was the net revenue in the last 30 days?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.line_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key) WHERE d.date > (SELECT max(d2.date) FROM fact_sales f2 JOIN dim_date d2 USING (date_key)) - INTERVAL 30 DAY
text: The net revenue in the last 30 days was £1,435,315.

question: How many new customers did the shop get in 2011?
sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT f.customer_key, MIN(f.invoice_ts) AS first_ts FROM fact_sales f WHERE NOT f.is_cancelled AND f.customer_key <> 0 GROUP BY 1) SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM firsts WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_ts) = 2011
text: The shop got 1,537 new customers in 2011.

question: By how much did net revenue change from September 2011 to October 2011 (October minus September)?
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT sum(CASE WHEN d.month = 9 AND d.year = 2011 THEN f.line_amount END) AS sep, sum(CASE WHEN d.month = 10 AND d.year = 2011 THEN f.line_amount END) AS oct FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_date d USING (date_key)) SELECT round(oct - sep, 2) AS revenue_change FROM m
text: Net revenue increased by £50,156.44 from September 2011 to October 2011.
